schema.label: Armor class
schema.formula: (armor_choiceNone * (10 + abilities_dexterity_mod) + armor_choiceLight * (armor_base + abilities_dexterity_mod) + armor_choiceMedium * (armor_base + min(abilities_dexterity_mod, 2)) + armor_choiceHeavy * armor_base + armor_choiceBarbarian * (10 + abilities_dexterity_mod + abilities_constitution_mod) + armor_choiceMonk * (10 + abilities_dexterity_mod + abilities_wisdom_mod * (1 - armor_shield)) + armor_choiceNatural * (armor_base + abilities_dexterity_mod)) + armor_shield * 2 + armor_misc

schema.label: To hit
schema.formula: record_abilityStrength * abilities_strength_mod + record_abilityDexterity * abilities_dexterity_mod + record_abilityConstitution * abilities_constitution_mod + record_abilityIntelligence * abilities_intelligence_mod + record_abilityWisdom * abilities_wisdom_mod + record_abilityCharisma * abilities_charisma_mod + identity_proficiencyBonus * record_proficient + record_misc
